contract.purpose: compare like-for-like SVI posterior features against SVI posterior economic-loss labels

development.composition: 300 original training plus 120 previously opened validation businesses, all development

posterior.features: stored SVI convergence, predictive calibration, ROI plausibility, ROI precision, seed agreement, and channel posterior centers

safety.convergence: finite posterior, stable ELBO, and cross-seed ROI agreement
safety.fallback: if no candidate passes every posterior gate, select from converged candidates for review only

comparison.unchanged: economic-loss target, linear Huber/quantile/ranking learner, business folds, candidate regions, search algorithms, and evaluation budgets
comparison.changed: posterior features and posterior-defined candidate safety pool

contract.purpose: replace proxy-score optimization with direct out-of-fold prediction of economic loss and tail risk

development.composition: 300 original training plus 120 previously opened validation businesses, all now treated as development

target.mean: uncapped within-business excess economic loss relative to the safe oracle
target.tail: conditional P90 of uncapped excess economic loss

crossFitting.assessmentPrediction: each candidate is predicted only by the model that excluded its parameter region
